phases.name: Core MQTT Implementation with rumqttc
phases.description: Replace simulated MQTT client with actual rumqttc implementation

subtasks.title: Implement actual rumqttc connection
subtasks.description: Replace the simulated connect() in DefaultMqttClient with actual rumqttc AsyncClient connection. Create MqttOptions with host, port, client_id, and keep_alive settings.
subtasks.notes: Replaced simulated connect() with actual rumqttc AsyncClient connection. Added MqttOptions with host, port, client_id, and keep_alive settings. Stored AsyncClient and EventLoop in struct fields for use by subsequent operations.

subtasks.title: Store AsyncClient and spawn event loop
subtasks.description: Store the rumqttc AsyncClient in the struct and spawn an async task to poll the event loop. Handle connection events and store them in state.
subtasks.notes: Spawned async task to poll rumqttc EventLoop. Added spawn_event_loop_task(), handle_event(), and handle_incoming() methods to process MQTT events. Handles ConnAck (connection confirmed), Publish (incoming messages), Disconnect, PingResp, and errors. Task handle stored for aborting on disconnect. Commit: f499fa8

subtasks.title: Implement actual publish operation
subtasks.description: Replace the simulated publish() with actual rumqttc client.publish() call. Convert QoS enum to rumqttc QoS.
subtasks.notes: Replaced simulated publish() with actual rumqttc client.publish() call. Added qos_to_rumqttc() helper function to convert our QoS enum to rumqttc's QoS. The publish method now acquires a read lock on the AsyncClient and calls client.publish() with proper QoS conversion and error handling. Added test for QoS conversion. Commit: b38e47e

subtasks.title: Implement actual subscribe/unsubscribe operations
subtasks.description: Replace simulated subscribe() and unsubscribe() with actual rumqttc calls.
subtasks.notes: Replaced simulated subscribe() and unsubscribe() with actual rumqttc calls. Both methods now acquire a read lock on the AsyncClient and call the respective rumqttc methods (client.subscribe() and client.unsubscribe()). QoS conversion is done via qos_to_rumqttc() helper for subscribe. Error handling uses MqttError::SubscribeFailed. Added unit tests for not-connected scenarios. Commit: ec59d78

subtasks.title: Handle incoming messages via event loop
subtasks.description: Process Incoming::Publish events from the event loop and dispatch to subscribed topic handlers via MqttEvent::MessageReceived.
subtasks.notes: Verified that Incoming::Publish handling is already fully implemented in handle_incoming() method (added in subtask 1.2). The method extracts topic and payload from the Publish packet, logs the message for debugging, and dispatches via event_tx.send(MqttEvent::MessageReceived { topic, payload }). Subscribers can receive messages via subscribe_events() which returns a broadcast::Receiver<MqttEvent>. No additional code changes needed.

phases.name: Reconnection & Reliability
phases.description: Implement automatic reconnection and connection monitoring

subtasks.title: Handle disconnect events in event loop
subtasks.description: Detect ConnectionError and Disconnect events from the event loop and update connection state accordingly.
subtasks.notes: Added ConnectionLost state and event for recoverable disconnections. Implemented handle_connection_error() to categorize connection errors and is_recoverable_error() to distinguish recoverable vs non-recoverable errors. Updated Incoming::Disconnect handling to trigger reconnection flow. Added connection_state() method to MqttClient trait. Exported ConnectionState type from mqtt module. Added tests for connection state and error recovery logic. Commit: be65058

subtasks.title: Implement automatic reconnection loop
subtasks.description: When disconnected, automatically attempt reconnection using the configured reconnect_interval_secs. Emit Reconnecting events.
subtasks.notes: Implemented automatic reconnection loop. Added reconnect_enabled AtomicBool flag to control auto-reconnection behavior. Modified spawn_event_loop_task() to detect recoverable errors and trigger spawn_reconnection_task(). The reconnection task waits for configured reconnect_interval_secs, emits MqttEvent::Reconnecting { attempt }, then creates a new AsyncClient and EventLoop. connect() enables auto-reconnection, disconnect() disables it. Added tests for reconnect flag behavior. Commit: 10d6e78

subtasks.title: Add connection monitoring and timeout handling
subtasks.description: Handle connection timeouts gracefully. Add configurable max reconnection attempts before giving up.
subtasks.notes: Added connection_timeout_secs and max_reconnect_attempts to MqttConfig. Connection timeout is applied to MqttOptions in both connect() and reconnection task. Shared reconnect_attempt counter tracks attempts across tasks, resets on ConnAck. When max_reconnect_attempts is exceeded, emits ReconnectionFailed event and stops reconnection. Added comprehensive tests. Commit: bdf957e

phases.name: TLS and Authentication Support
phases.description: Add secure connection and authentication capabilities

subtasks.title: Add TLS configuration to MqttOptions
subtasks.description: When use_tls is enabled, configure rumqttc with TLS settings using the rustls feature.
subtasks.notes: Implemented TLS configuration for MQTT client. Added TlsConfiguration and Transport imports from rumqttc. Created configure_tls() helper function that uses TlsConfiguration::default() with system CA certificates. Applied TLS configuration in both connect() method and spawn_reconnection_task(). Added unit tests for TLS config defaults and configure_tls function. Commit: 0bf8b19

subtasks.title: Integrate keyring for password storage
subtasks.description: Use the keyring crate (already in dependencies) to securely store and retrieve MQTT broker password.
subtasks.notes: Implemented MqttCredentialStore using keyring crate for secure MQTT password storage. Added store_password(), get_password(), and delete_password() methods. Updated DefaultMqttClient with credential_store field and configure_credentials() helper. Both connect() and spawn_reconnection_task() now retrieve passwords from the OS keyring when username is set. Added comprehensive unit tests. Commit: ca7092d

subtasks.title: Add password field to settings UI
subtasks.description: Add a secure password input field to the MQTT settings section that saves to keyring.
subtasks.notes: Added secure password input field to MQTT settings UI. Implemented MqttCredentialStore integration in SettingsScreen with: mqtt_password_input buffer for password entry, set_mqtt_config() method that loads password from keyring on init, password field appears only when username is set, password masked with password(true), saves to keyring on focus lost, empty password deletes from keyring, username change clears password. Commit: 4f157d2
